content:
maya: quick design review — I'm worried the suppression preview modal looks crowded when there are 5+ channels selected. screenshot: https://figma.com/file/abc123 (mock)
sam: agree, it gets noisy. propose collapsing into a compact list with a `+N more` pill and a horizontal scroll on hover.
leo: also the little triggered badge (red) fails contrast at small size — I measured ~2.8:1. should aim for 4.5:1 for body text.
devlin: copy thought: instead of 'Suppress notifications for X' maybe 'Pause notifications for X' — feels clearer to product folks and less scary to users.
a11y-bot: accessibility note: suppression toggle needs an explicit aria-label, e.g. `aria-label=\"Pause notifications for {channel}\"`. Also ensure focus order: modal close -> heading -> controls -> preview list.
maya: good call. i18n follow-up: 'Pause' is shorter than 'Suppress' for a few locales, gives more room for long channel names in the same line.
sam: keyboard nav idea: allow arrow keys to move through channels in the preview and space/enter to toggle pause. currently only tab works which is clumsy.
leo: mini spec: ArrowLeft/Right to move selection, Space/Enter toggles, Esc closes the modal. We'll need visible focus ring + high-contrast focus color.
devlin: microcopy tweak: change header from 'Preview' to 'Notification preview — triggers & recipients' so users know what the preview contains at a glance.
maya: LGTM. I'll add that to the figma file and update the component name.
sam: UX clarity: threshold chips should read `If > 80% errors in 5m` rather than `80% errors` — adds the time window which is critical for signal understanding.
leo: edge-case: when multiple thresholds are configured and overlapping, the preview must show which threshold matched per channel (e.g., small tag: `matched: 5m-80%`).
a11y-bot: final checklist: (1) color-only indicators need text label (e.g., 'Critical'), (2) aria-labels for all toggles, (3) focus order validated with screen reader, (4) contrast >= 4.5:1 for body and 3:1 for large text. :white_check_mark:
maya: thanks everyone — I'll iterate tonight, push updated components to the design system, and ping once Figma is updated.
